svg.title: BGA pads in a copper pour: straight in, or joined by a short trace
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan views of the corner of a 0.8 mm-pitch BGA with 0.35 mm pads and mask openings 0.45 mm across, on a ground pour. Left, wrong: three ground pads sit straight in the pour, so the whole 0.45 mm opening shows copper and those pads come out bigger than the rest. Right, right: the pour is kept back from every pad, and each ground pad is joined to it by a 0.15 mm trace, so all the pads show the same 0.35 mm of copper.

g.text: ✗ Ground pads straight in the pour
✓ Ground pads joined by a short trace
The 0.45 mm opening sets its size
Pad on its own: 0.35 mm of copper
Drawn to scale. 0.8 mm pitch, 0.35 mm pads, 0.45 mm mask openings and 0.2 mm pour clearance.
The same applies to QFN and DFN pads.
